brief: Best Opportunity: deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness - Plugin-based framework for AI tools
Breakout Timing: Immediate - Growing demand for customizable AI tooling
Runner-up: stablyai/orca - ADE for managing parallel AI agents
Emerging: heygen-com/hyperframes - AI-powered HTML to video rendering for agents
Keep an Eye On: webadderallorg/Recordly - AI-powered demo video creation tool

items.name: cathrynlavery/diagram-design
items.one_liner: High-quality SVG diagram library for AI coding assistants
items.pain_point: AI coding assistants generate ugly diagrams; developers building AI-powered products need professional visual outputs that look editorial-quality, not generic Mermaid slop
app_ideas: Diagram API service for AI agents (per-call pricing)
VS Code extension with diagram palette for AI-assisted docs
Web app: describe diagram → get clean SVG code
items.monetization: B2B API wrapper with generous free tier, then usage-based pricing per diagram render
items.why_now: AI coding assistants (Claude Code, Codex) are exploding and their visual output quality is the next frontier
